criteria.name: Content Quality
criteria.feedback: Your submission accurately notes that technology is important in daily life, but it remains too general and lacks specific examples or analysis—especially in a biology context. To improve, try including concrete examples and discuss in more detail how technology impacts biology.

criteria.name: Writing Mechanics
criteria.feedback: Your writing is clear, grammatically correct, and professional throughout, demonstrating excellent mastery of mechanics.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.feedback: Your essay introduces the topic and provides some body content, but it lacks a conclusion, clear separation into paragraphs, and effective transitions, resulting in poor organization. To improve your structure, consider adding a concluding statement, separating your ideas into multiple paragraphs, and avoiding repeating the title as your first line.

criteria.name: Research and Citations
criteria.feedback: Your submission did not include any outside research or citations, which are required for this assignment; be sure to integrate and properly cite sources in future essays to improve your score.
